caption:
There's a version of a man nobody ever sees. Not his friends. Not his family. Not even the person he loves. 🌙

He questions everything at night: his choices, his worth, his future. Then in the morning he gets up, smiles and plays his role like nothing happened.

The strongest man you know might be the one struggling the most in silence. Check on him.
